svg.data-power-input: 100 - 240 V AC, two inputs (IEC C14), built-in supplies with failover
svg.data-cooling: two built-in fans, temperature based fan control
svg.data-optics-sfp: brochure: twenty SFP cages for 1G modules and four combo SFP cages, none included
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: brochure: four SFP+ cages for 10G modules, none included
svg.data-combo-ports: four combo ports, each a gigabit RJ45 jack and an SFP cage of which only one can be used at a time (quick guide)
